policy: Review every closed candidate set. Select only when ASV wording or an explicit mapped textual note distinguishes a reading; otherwise mark underdetermined and retain the base fallback. The base candidate is the SBLGNT reading.

decisions.evidence: ASV text reads "God's minister" (diakonon); the mapped textual_variant note relegates the other reading to the margin: "Some ancient authorities read fellow-worker with God" (synergon).

ASV has only "God's minister in the gospel of Christ" with no conjoined "and our fellow-worker"; the fellow-worker wording appears solely in the margin, so the added kai synergon hemon is not in the rendered text.

"to comfort you concerning your faith" renders either reading: "concerning" answers hyper as readily as peri, and the object "you" carries over from "to establish you" whether or not hymas is expressed. No ASV note is mapped to this unit.
ASV orders the pair "in all our distress and affliction" — anagke then thlipsis — matching the base sequence rather than the transposed one.
ASV reads "our Lord Jesus" with no "Christ"; the only note here is classed alternative_rendering and concerns "God himself and our Father", so the added Christos is absent from the rendered text.
ASV reads "our Lord Jesus with all his saints" with no "Christ"; the mapped textual_variant note concerns the added Amen, not this word, so nothing supports the longer name.
ASV ends the verse at "with all his saints" and puts the addition in the margin: "Many ancient authorities add Amen", so the text follows the reading without amen.
